message.reasoning: Mark each criterion. C1: intro covers mission, rationale, single satellite, users — good, some referencing. Accomplished ~8. C2: launch, orbit elements, manoeuvres, ground control, comms frequency, duration/EOL, STK screenshots. Some errors: "very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" (error), drag sail section garbled, no hand calcs shown beyond inclination plot, no software files mentioned. Adequate-to-accomplished; give 7. C3: conclusion decent but somewhat generic; 6. C4: structure good, figures labelled minimally (some captions), references are bare URLs, Wikipedia used as source [6] — violates R15. Adequate 5.
